Resource.Desc: Orders: XRequest (product lookup) + Kotlin script (validate, price, sign) + SQL transaction + external notification, in one request.

Transaction.Sql: INSERT INTO orders (customer_id, total, status, token) VALUES ($customer_id, $[calc].total, 'NEW', $[calc].token)
INSERT INTO order_line (order_id, product_id, qty, price) VALUES ((SELECT MAX(id) FROM orders WHERE token = $[calc].token), $product_id, $qty, $[calc].price)
UPDATE product SET stock = stock - $qty WHERE id = $product_id

Request.Sql: SELECT o.id, o.total, o.status, o.token, c.name AS customer FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.token = $[calc].token
SELECT id, customer_id, total, status FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $customer_id ORDER BY id
SELECT id, customer_id, total, status FROM orders WHERE status = $status ORDER BY id
SELECT id, customer_id, total, status FROM orders ORDER BY id
SELECT o.id, o.total, o.status, c.name AS customer, c.email FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.id = $id
SELECT p.sku, p.name, l.qty, l.price FROM order_line l JOIN product p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE l.order_id = $id
SELECT status FROM orders WHERE id = $id
UPDATE orders SET status = $status WHERE id = $id
